name: Gay Pride Rainbow Flags - 12" x 18" (Make America Gay Again)
description: PRIDE FLAG of the iconic rainbow stripes of red, orange, yellow, green, blue & purple MAKE AMERICA GAY AGAIN poke to the president pops against the vibrant colors of the rainbow BIG 12" x 18" cloth flags fly flamboyantly at parties, parades & celebrations; PLAYFUL way to send a clear message of what side of history you are on; PERFECT ACCESSORY for LGBTQ & political events, rallies, parades, peaceful protests; If youre both playful and prideful, this is so your flag! This iconic rainbow pride flag has been graced with the newly notable political poke, Make America Gay Again. The 12" x 18" boldly striped cloth flag is the perfect accessory to flaunt at pride festivals, parades & celebrations, as well as peaceful protests, events & rallies. The witty white words pop against the vivid red, orange, yellow, green, blue & purple stripes, and the flag itself is attached to a 24" long wooden dowel. Any & everyone, including the aliens, can proudly parade this powerful pennant. Love indeed, makes the world go round!
